text.en:
3246
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
ed in me by section 53 of Commonwealth Act No. 470, as
amended by Commonwealth Act No. 534, and upon the
recommendation of the Secretary of Finance, do hereby
remit the 50% of the 1352 taxes on all real properties
located in the Province of Masbate on condition that all
the unpaid taxes and penalties corresponding to 1951 and
previous years and the remaining 50% of the 1952 taxes
shall be paid on or before August 31, 1953.
Executive order No. 592, dated May 8, 1953, is hereby
amended accordingly.
Done in Washington, D.C., U.S.A. (for Manila, Philip-
pines), this 22nd day of August, in the year of Our Lord,
nineteen hundred and fifty-three, and of the Independence
of the Philippines, the eighth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
